evidence.quote: We propose a $32 million class fund with automatic distribution. The proposed fee reflects the work invested
Fees were discussed from the first round, not only after class relief was agreed.
We can accept your $5 million fee figure, subject to court approval, if Brightline increases the class fund to $28 million.

summary: Plaintiffs raised fees in their opening term sheets, and the final declaration confirms fees were discussed from the first round before class relief was settled. There is explicit linkage where Whitcombe Reyes conditions acceptance of the $5 million fee figure on an increased class fund. The transcript does not clearly show class counsel prioritizing firm economics over the class, defense leveraging fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
